title: Counting Bits
prompt:
Given `n`, return an array `ans` of length `n + 1` where `ans[i]` is the number of 1-bits in `i`.

**Example**: `n = 5` → `[0,1,1,2,1,2]`.

Aim for O(n) overall by reusing answers for smaller numbers.
hints: How does the binary form of `i` relate to the binary form of `i / 2`?
`i >> 1` is `i` with its lowest bit dropped. It is smaller than `i`, so you already know its answer.

solution.explanation: Shifting right drops exactly the lowest bit, so i has the same set bits as i >> 1 plus `i & 1`. Since i >> 1 < i, its entry is already filled in. O(n) time, O(n) space for the output.
